Independent destructive-time-course evidence. The Issue 220 independent-time-course fixture
experiment uses the rna layer to assess the declared condition target contrasts treatment with
control. (A) Component PC1 shows individual observations and stored population trajectories;
the standardized condition-by-time interaction is 1.98 [1.95, 2.00]. (B) Component PC2 shows
individual observations and stored population trajectories; the standardized condition-by-time
interaction is -0.00 [-0.11, 0.07]. Points show independent biological observations; labels
give biological sample counts per design cell; crosses mark unobserved condition-by-time cells;
lines show stored population trajectories. The analysis unit is independent biological
observation; the design is independent_time_course; the estimand is condition-by-time
interaction on the rank scale; time is recorded as day; adjustment uses batch. Facet labels
report stored interaction estimates and 95% intervals; resampling recurrence remains in the
evidence. Raw p-values are retained; q-values use Holm correction across declared components
within each metadata field and evidence variant. No acceptance threshold is applied. Trajectory
evidence is exploratory and does not establish biological validity.
